text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin my evaluation, could you please describe the specific appearance and location of the skin lesions you are concerned about? I would also like to know how long they have been present and if they have changed in size, color, or shape recently.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of smoking and the non-healing nature of these lesions, I need to assess your immune status and risk factors.
